# Fetch the habit tracker note
note = apis.simple_note.get_note(note_id="1")
content = note["content"]

# Parse lines: skip the first line (habit description)
lines = content.split("\n")
# First line is "Habit: limited screen time to 1 hr"
# Remaining lines are "YYYY-MM-DD: yes/no"
streak = 0
max_streak = 0
for line in lines[1:]:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    # Split on ": " to get date and status
    parts = line.split(": ")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    status = parts[1].strip().lower()
    if status == "yes":
        streak += 1
        if streak > max_streak:
            max_streak = streak
    else:
        streak = 0

print(max_streak)

content = note["content"]

# Parse lines: skip the first line (habit description)
lines = content.split("\n")
# First line is "Habit: limited screen time to 1 hr"
# Remaining lines are "YYYY-MM-DD: yes/no"
streak = 0
max_streak = 0
for line in lines[1:]:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    # Split on ": " to get date and status
    parts = line.split(": ")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        continue
    status = parts[1].strip().lower()
    if status == "yes":
        streak += 1
        if streak > max_streak:
            max_streak = streak
    else:
        streak = 0

print(max_streak)
